card.name: Slash or bracket before a unit abbreviation
card.fires_on: The opening parenthesis or slash that comes right before a measurement unit, such as kilograms or MBq, in dose tables and unit expressions. It fires on the punctuation after a unit or heading, where another unit is about to start.

modes.label: Parenthesis before unit
modes.description: An opening parenthesis after a table heading like Weight Range, just before the unit name.
modes.example: Weight Range<< (>>kilograms) Recommended Dose up to

modes.label: Slash in compound units
modes.description: A slash after a unit like μGy or mSv, just before MBq or 1,000 m.
modes.example: multiply the dose in μGy<</>>MBq by 0.00

card.writes: It favors tokens starting with m or k, which fits the start of units like MBq, mL, kg and m.
card.plain: It marks the spot where a measurement unit such as MBq or kg is about to be written, after a slash or opening bracket.
